focused_tests.command: pixi run --locked python -m pytest warrior_simulation/igvc2027/test warrior_navigation/test

ros_package_build.scope: Final build after dependency metadata updates and artifact regeneration
ros_package_build.warning: Existing warrior_bringup CMake compatibility deprecation warning for versions below 3.10; build succeeded.

deterministic_regeneration.scope: Scene JSON, Gazebo SDF, Isaac USD, generated waypoint/profile YAML and COLLADA meshes

geographic_and_collision_checks.encoding: Packed DMS interpretation inferred from organizer image and geographic footprint; source horizontal datum unspecified, WGS84 assumed
geographic_and_collision_checks.orthophoto: Oakland County 2025; native 0.0762 m resolution; source metadata/georeference in reference/
geographic_and_collision_checks.elevation: USGS Oakland County 2017 acquisition; native 1 m NAVD88; relative-height alignment only

background_independent_geometry_audit.method: One-off independent Shapely union/intersection compared with independently projected aerial extent minus P37 outline; production tests do not require Shapely

paint_surface_check.method: Independent barycentric interpolation of actual asphalt triangles; vertices and triangle centers checked for lane tape, gates, and pothole disks

other_tests: WGS84 independent geodesic axes and ENU roundtrip
Actual terrain pixel-center sampling and aerial UV corner alignment
Asphalt area, boundary containment and shared interior edges
Closed curb solids with positive signed volume
Watertight ramp and actual surface grade <= 15%
Robot footprint connectivity from spawn through all four targets
Generated GPS altitudes and spawn clearance against actual mesh
Historical registration preserves 2027 marker geometry and 152.4 m loop scale
Two-target diagnostic uses true endpoints separated by more than 30 m
One Gazebo static body preserves shared object poses, materials, collisions and mesh UVs

long_leg_diagnostic.cleanup: Gazebo, RViz and associated test processes stopped after completion.

gui.observation: Menu state changes were visible in screenshots completed about 0.42 s after each click (250 ms intentional wait plus capture overhead). Escape dismissed the menu; camera follow/zoom changed the view. This is a screenshot observation, not a general input-latency benchmark.

real_time_factor_snapshot.note: One observed snapshot, not an average or performance guarantee.

long_leg_diagnostic.reason: Long-distance waypoint diagnostic tested separately in Gazebo

robot_and_sensors.cleanup: Runtime exited after the 155 s bounded session; associated simulator/bridge processes were stopped.

command_loss_watchdog.scope: Bounded physical command-transport test: valid commands during simulation t=2–3 s, stale packets during t=4–5 s and nonfinite packets during t=5–6 s.

stage_validation.scope: OpenUSD structural checks; actual runtime validation is recorded separately in robot_and_sensors.

limits: 2027 targets and obstacle arrangement are schematic reconstruction, not a surveyed final 2027 course.
Published 2026 coordinate encoding is inferred; numeric precision does not establish positioning accuracy.
2017 DEM supports broad terrain relief; curb sections, tree heights/canopies and other vertical features are inferred.
Relative NAVD88 elevation is aligned to the inherited WGS84 simulation anchor without claiming a geoid conversion.
Ground filtering uses measured lidar only; objects below thresholds, sparse distant returns and drop-offs are not guaranteed detectable.
No real-world GPS noise, wheel slip, physical sensor calibration or outdoor safety validation is claimed.
